data_point: Recently parted ways with, or is replacing, a bookkeeper or fractional CFO
run_when: A bookkeeper or finance role is open, or search results are available.

prompt.task: Decide whether the company recently parted ways with, or is replacing, a bookkeeper or fractional CFO.
yes_when: A job post to replace or bring in-house the bookkeeping
A public post about changing bookkeepers
no_when: Not applicable; use unknown when nothing is found
unknown_when: Just an open finance role with no sign of replacing anyone
watch_out_for: A new first finance hire is a different signal
Job sites mix employers with similar names: a listing counts only if its employer is this company (same company page, domain or location), e.g. 'Argon' is not 'Argon AI'

evidence_quote.description: Exact words copied from the text. Empty when the answer is unknown.

source.description: Page name or URL the quote came from.

reason.description: One plain sentence explaining the answer.

queries: "{company}" bookkeeper OR accountant jobs site:builtin.com OR site:ziprecruiter.com OR site:linkedin.com/jobs OR site:ycombinator.com OR site:wellfound.com
site:linkedin.com/posts ("{company}" OR "{founders}") bookkeeper OR "fractional CFO" OR accounting
good_sources: job sites (Built In, ZipRecruiter, LinkedIn Jobs, YC Work at a Startup, Wellfound)
LinkedIn posts by the company or its founders (public, indexed ones)
